[LLEX.10.8.3] **State isolation.** The non-`XID` `TYPE_SYM` glyphs must remain
state-restricted to type positions — they must not be lexable in an identifier
state. With the glob mode removed ([LLEX.10.7]), `*` is unconditionally the
multiply operator and `.<name>` unconditionally slot access, so no
parser-state-dependent lexing remains; the implementation must confirm the
`TYPE_SYM`-glyph isolation after the character-class broadening.
